items.name: erdos-problem-347-parametric
items.description: This work formalizes and extends Barschkis's original construction, which provided the first concrete instance of Tao's 2025 sketch for Problem 347. The parametric framework presented here generalizes Barschkis's parameters (κₙ = kₙ, α = 3/2) and proves that any EventuallyExpanding parameter choice achieves natural density 1.
